title: Record P1 and P2 multilingual fallback policy

sources.reason: Current schema v2 topic inventory to extend with representative P1/P2 records.
Current topic and journey validator to enforce explicit P1 fallback labels.
Canonical P1/P2 policy and fallback boundary.
Reader-facing English fallback wording already merged and must remain aligned.
Reader-facing Chinese fallback wording already merged and must remain aligned.
Reader-facing Japanese fallback wording already merged and must remain aligned.

rawUserRequest: 部分 P1/P2 技术参考仍只有英文版本，这个限制需要对应：记录在 topic inventory 中，明确 P1 English fallback 与 P2 默认不翻译边界，但不要宣称全部多语言覆盖完成。继续按完整 WI 流程执行。

declaredIntent.summary: Make the existing P1/P2 English-only limitation machine-readable and fail closed when a P1 fallback label is missing.

riskAssessment.reason: A missing fallback label can make English-only technical detail look like complete localized coverage.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The change is bounded to registry metadata, validator behavior, and focused tests.

preReviewWarnings: Verify P1 records carry an explicit English fallback label, P2 records do not imply a translation obligation, and no P0 status changes.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The schema v2 registry contains representative P1 and P2 topics with explicit localization policy metadata and existing canonical paths.
The journey validator requires a non-empty English fallback label for active P1 topics with no ja/zh-CN route, while allowing P2 English-only records without treating them as complete localization.
Focused tests cover valid fallback records and fail-closed missing-label cases; existing P0 topic validation and journey checks remain green.
The registry and validator preserve the reader-facing warning that incomplete P1/P2 localization is not complete multilingual coverage.
guidelines: Keep P1 fallback labels explicit and machine-readable; do not infer completion from an English path alone.
Do not modify P0 enforcement status or weaken existing multilingual journey checks.
Keep validation deterministic and side-effect free.

intent.problem: The entry pages honestly warn that some P1/P2 technical references remain English-only, but the registry does not record that limitation. A future reader or maintainer could mistake an English technical path for complete multilingual coverage.
constraints: Do not translate or rewrite P1/P2 reference content in this WI.
Do not change any P0 topic status or entry-page wording.
Use the existing registry and validator; do not create a second policy source.
intent.rationale: Recording fallback policy beside topic criticality makes the limitation inspectable and prevents future coverage overclaims without forcing unnecessary translation work.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An active P1 topic with only an English route and an explicit fallback label passes.
An active P1 topic with only an English route and no fallback label fails closed.
An active P2 English-only topic remains allowed without implying complete multilingual coverage.
scenarioCoverage.expected: validation passes with P2 policy metadata
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused P2 policy test and registry inspection.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.
